    "outcome_measure": "Response sensitivity (d') in a composite-task paradigm, specifically the Congruency by Alignment interaction.",
    "population_and_setting": "University students in Tübingen, Germany.",
    "sample_size_total": 22,
    "recruitment_and_incentive": "Not stated.",
    "analysis_plan": "Repeated measures ANOVA to test for a Congruency by Alignment interaction, followed by t-tests to compare congruency effects in aligned versus misaligned conditions.",
    "preregistered_or_confirmatory": "not stated",
    "other_methods_notes": "Participants performed a composite task where they judged whether the top halves of two stimuli were the same or different while ignoring the bottom halves. The stimuli were either faces or line patterns designed to convey Gestalt information."
